# My Draft Strategist

My Draft Strategist is a toolset for fantasy football drafting and roster management.

## Key Pages
- [Setup](https://mydraftstrategist.com/index.html)
- [Tracker](https://mydraftstrategist.com/index.html#tracker)
- [Team](https://mydraftstrategist.com/index.html#team)
- [Draft Board](https://mydraftstrategist.com/index.html#board)
- [My Lineup Strategist](https://mydraftstrategist.com/lineup/index.html)
- [T-Score Methodology](https://mydraftstrategist.com/t-score/index.html)

## Description
This application provides data-driven draft strategies, lineup optimization, and roster management tools for fantasy football players.
